evidence.notes: Typed String query with USER_MODE returns persisted Account rows.
Typed String count query with USER_MODE returns the seeded row count.
Typed count query and binds with USER_MODE return the matching count.
Inline SOQL produces an iterable QueryLocator.
Typed String query with USER_MODE produces an iterable QueryLocator.

source.content: insert new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Hot Account', Rating = 'Hot'), new Account(Name = 'Warm Account', Rating = 'Warm')}; List<Account> allRows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, allRows.size()); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>{'rating' => 'Warm'}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.countQuery('SELECT Id FROM Account', AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); System.assertEquals(1, Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); Database.QueryLocator listLocator = Database.getQueryLocator([SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account ORDER BY Name]); Object listIterator = listLocator.iterator(); System.assert(listIterator.hasNext()); Database.QueryLocator stringLocator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Object stringIterator = stringLocator.iterator(); System.assert(stringIterator.hasNext());
